correctness.rationale: For the new map all jumps are positive and all branch slopes lie in (0,1); strict monotonicity rules out longer cycles. Away from finitely many threshold coincidences every orbit converges to an attracting branch fixed point. Exactly i-1 cuts below u_i characterizes the i-th fixed point. Exact multinomial block counts yield the factorial-moment coefficient formula; uniform Stirling bounds on all positive compositions and integrable Dirichlet limits give every normalized moment 2^(k/2)Gamma(1+k/2). Rayleigh moment determinacy, Stirling saturation asymptotics and exact n<=8 exhaustive occupancy verification complete the checks. Finite checks are supporting only.

value.rationale: This natural uniform-cut parameter ensemble tests the sharp n-orbit bound from established interval-contraction dynamics. The exact all-moment distribution proves typical order sqrt(n), a nondegenerate Rayleigh fluctuation law, and exponential rarity of saturation, furnishing quantitative information absent from the upper bound and qualitative generic periodicity alone.
